description: Part 9 lesson 09-07 checkpoint. Creates the single order-summary routine ORDER_SUMMARY_JSON (SPECIFIC ORDSUMJSN, LANGUAGE SQL scalar function on the base tables, source solutions/09-07/09-07-summary.sql loaded into member QSQLSRC/SUMMARY and run with RUNSQLSTM from inside the wrapper job). Records what the routine really created (QSYS2.SYSROUTINES row, OBJECT_STATISTICS by name and by creation time) to settle the TXCKM object name and type. Calls it in-job (qualified, unqualified through the library list, N = 3, 1, 20, 0) into VFYSUM and parses the JSON back with JSON_TABLE in collect (expected with load_v1 data: orders J00008, J00007, J00006 for N = 3, lowStockCount 2). Seeds TXCKM rows for lesson 09-07 (row 1 is inserted from the catalog so it reports the real type; row 2 ZAIKOM *FILE; row 3 is the *SRVPGM guess) and runs TXCHECK through the *CMD route (TXCHKRUN helper from part06-15) once, then a second time in the same job on purpose (08-08 found CPF4174 on the second call). After the wrapper: a fresh-job qualified call through db2 (what a learner sees in ACS), then DROP SPECIFIC FUNCTION and removal of the 09-07 TXCKM rows in sh(after) steps. TXCKM, TXCHECK, TXCHKRUN are shared state and are never deleted; only rows with LESSON 09-07 are touched. The private library is never written.

steps.label: CURSET
steps.cmd: CHGCURLIB CURLIB(&LIB)

steps.label: MKCUR
steps.cmd: RUNSQL SQL('CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE &LIB/VFYCUR (TAG VARCHAR(40), ORD INT, LIB VARCHAR(20), TYPE VARCHAR(10))') COMMIT(*NONE)

steps.label: REC0
steps.cmd: RUNSQL SQL('INSERT INTO &LIB/VFYCUR SELECT ''A0-AFTER-CHGCURLIB'', ORDINAL_POSITION, SCHEMA_NAME, TYPE FROM QSYS2.LIBRARY_LIST_INFO') COMMIT(*NONE)

steps.label: PRECLEAN
steps.cmd: RUNSQL SQL('DROP SPECIFIC FUNCTION &LIB/ORDSUMJSN') COMMIT(*NONE)

steps.label: CPTXCKM
steps.cmd:
CHKOBJ OBJ(&LIB/TXCKM) OBJTYPE(*FILE)
MONMSG MSGID(CPF9801) EXEC(CRTPF FILE(&LIB/TXCKM) SRCFILE(&LIB/QDDSSRC) SRCMBR(TXCKM))

steps.label: CPTXCHECK
steps.cmd:
CHKOBJ OBJ(&LIB/TXCHECK) OBJTYPE(*PGM)
MONMSG MSGID(CPF9801) EXEC(CRTCLPGM PGM(&LIB/TXCHECK) SRCFILE(&LIB/QCLSRC) SRCMBR(TXCHECK))

steps.label: CPTXCHKCMD
steps.cmd:
DLTCMD CMD(&LIB/TXCHECK)
MONMSG MSGID(CPF0000)
CRTCMD CMD(&LIB/TXCHECK) PGM(&LIB/TXCHECK) SRCFILE(&LIB/QCMDSRC) SRCMBR(TXCHECK)

steps.label: CPTXCHKRUN
steps.cmd: CRTCLPGM PGM(&LIB/TXCHKRUN) SRCFILE(&LIB/QCLSRC) SRCMBR(TXCHKRUN) REPLACE(*YES)

steps.label: MKSUM
steps.cmd: RUNSQLSTM SRCFILE(&LIB/QSQLSRC) SRCMBR(SUMMARY) COMMIT(*NONE) NAMING(*SQL) DFTRDBCOL(&LIB) ERRLVL(30)

steps.label: DCATA
steps.cmd: RUNSQL SQL('DROP TABLE &LIB/VFYCAT') COMMIT(*NONE)

steps.label: CATA
steps.cmd: RUNSQL SQL('CREATE TABLE &LIB/VFYCAT AS (SELECT * FROM QSYS2.SYSROUTINES WHERE SPECIFIC_SCHEMA = ''&LIB'' AND ROUTINE_NAME = ''ORDER_SUMMARY_JSON'') WITH DATA') COMMIT(*NONE)

steps.label: DCATB
steps.cmd: RUNSQL SQL('DROP TABLE &LIB/VFYOBJ') COMMIT(*NONE)

steps.label: CATB
steps.cmd: RUNSQL SQL('CREATE TABLE &LIB/VFYOBJ AS (SELECT OBJNAME, OBJTYPE, OBJATTRIBUTE, OBJTEXT FROM TABLE(QSYS2.OBJECT_STATISTICS(''&LIB'', ''*ALL'')) X WHERE OBJNAME LIKE ''ORDSUM%'' OR OBJNAME LIKE ''ORDER_SUM%'') WITH DATA') COMMIT(*NONE)

steps.label: DCATC
steps.cmd: RUNSQL SQL('DROP TABLE &LIB/VFYOBJN') COMMIT(*NONE)

steps.label: CATC
steps.cmd: RUNSQL SQL('CREATE TABLE &LIB/VFYOBJN AS (SELECT OBJNAME, OBJTYPE, OBJATTRIBUTE, OBJCREATED FROM TABLE(QSYS2.OBJECT_STATISTICS(''&LIB'', ''*ALL'')) X WHERE OBJCREATED > CURRENT TIMESTAMP - 30 MINUTES) WITH DATA') COMMIT(*NONE)

steps.label: MKSUM2
steps.cmd: RUNSQL SQL('CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE &LIB/VFYSUM (TAG VARCHAR(20), J VARCHAR(4000) CCSID 1208)') COMMIT(*NONE)

steps.label: CALLQ3
steps.cmd: RUNSQL SQL('INSERT INTO &LIB.VFYSUM SELECT ''Q3-QUAL'', &LIB.ORDER_SUMMARY_JSON(3) FROM SYSIBM.SYSDUMMY1') COMMIT(*NONE) NAMING(*SQL)

steps.label: CALLU3
steps.cmd: RUNSQL SQL('INSERT INTO &LIB/VFYSUM SELECT ''Q3-UNQUAL'', ORDER_SUMMARY_JSON(3) FROM SYSIBM.SYSDUMMY1') COMMIT(*NONE)

steps.label: CALLQ1
steps.cmd: RUNSQL SQL('INSERT INTO &LIB.VFYSUM SELECT ''Q1'', &LIB.ORDER_SUMMARY_JSON(1) FROM SYSIBM.SYSDUMMY1') COMMIT(*NONE) NAMING(*SQL)

steps.label: CALLQ20
steps.cmd: RUNSQL SQL('INSERT INTO &LIB.VFYSUM SELECT ''Q20'', &LIB.ORDER_SUMMARY_JSON(20) FROM SYSIBM.SYSDUMMY1') COMMIT(*NONE) NAMING(*SQL)

steps.label: CALLQ0
steps.cmd: RUNSQL SQL('INSERT INTO &LIB.VFYSUM SELECT ''Q0'', &LIB.ORDER_SUMMARY_JSON(0) FROM SYSIBM.SYSDUMMY1') COMMIT(*NONE) NAMING(*SQL)

steps.label: SEEDDEL
steps.cmd: RUNSQL SQL('DELETE FROM &LIB/TXCKM WHERE LESSON = ''09-07''') COMMIT(*NONE)

steps.label: SEED1
steps.cmd: RUNSQL SQL('INSERT INTO &LIB/TXCKM SELECT ''09-07'', 1, OBJNAME, OBJTYPE, '' '', ''ORDSUMJSN routine object exists'' FROM TABLE(QSYS2.OBJECT_STATISTICS(''&LIB'', ''*ALL'')) X WHERE OBJNAME = ''ORDSUMJSN'' FETCH FIRST 1 ROW ONLY') COMMIT(*NONE)

steps.label: SEED2
steps.cmd: RUNSQL SQL('INSERT INTO &LIB/TXCKM VALUES (''09-07'', 2, ''ZAIKOM'', ''*FILE'', '' '', ''ZAIKOM base table exists'')') COMMIT(*NONE)

steps.label: SEED3
steps.cmd: RUNSQL SQL('INSERT INTO &LIB/TXCKM VALUES (''09-07'', 3, ''ORDSUMJSN'', ''*SRVPGM'', '' '', ''ORDSUMJSN is a service program (guess)'')') COMMIT(*NONE)

steps.label: TXCHK1
steps.cmd: CALL PGM(&LIB/TXCHKRUN) PARM('09-07' '&LIB')

steps.label: TXCHK2
steps.cmd: CALL PGM(&LIB/TXCHKRUN) PARM('09-07' '&LIB')

steps.label: FRESHCALL
steps.cmd: db2 "SELECT &LIB.ORDER_SUMMARY_JSON(2) AS J FROM SYSIBM.SYSDUMMY1" 2>&1

steps.label: OBJBEFORE
steps.cmd: db2 "SELECT OBJNAME, OBJTYPE FROM TABLE(QSYS2.OBJECT_STATISTICS('&LIB', '*ALL')) X WHERE OBJNAME = 'ORDSUMJSN'" 2>&1

steps.label: DROPF
steps.cmd: system "RUNSQL SQL('DROP SPECIFIC FUNCTION &LIB/ORDSUMJSN') COMMIT(*NONE)" 2>&1

steps.label: CLNSEED
steps.cmd: system "RUNSQL SQL('DELETE FROM &LIB/TXCKM WHERE LESSON = ''09-07''') COMMIT(*NONE)" 2>&1

steps.label: GONE
steps.cmd: db2 "SELECT COUNT(*) AS ROUTINES_LEFT FROM QSYS2.SYSROUTINES WHERE SPECIFIC_SCHEMA = '&LIB' AND ROUTINE_NAME = 'ORDER_SUMMARY_JSON'" 2>&1; db2 "SELECT OBJNAME, OBJTYPE FROM TABLE(QSYS2.OBJECT_STATISTICS('&LIB', '*ALL')) X WHERE OBJNAME = 'ORDSUMJSN'" 2>&1

steps.sql: SELECT TAG, ORD, LIB, TYPE FROM &LIB.VFYCUR ORDER BY TAG, ORD
SELECT ROUTINE_SCHEMA, ROUTINE_NAME, SPECIFIC_NAME, ROUTINE_TYPE, EXTERNAL_NAME FROM &LIB.VFYCAT
SELECT OBJNAME, OBJTYPE, OBJATTRIBUTE, OBJTEXT FROM &LIB.VFYOBJ ORDER BY OBJNAME, OBJTYPE
SELECT OBJNAME, OBJTYPE, OBJATTRIBUTE, OBJCREATED FROM &LIB.VFYOBJN ORDER BY OBJCREATED, OBJNAME
SELECT TAG, J FROM &LIB.VFYSUM ORDER BY TAG

SELECT S.TAG, T.LOW_CNT, T.ORD_NO, T.ORD_DATE, T.LINE_CNT, T.AMT FROM &LIB.VFYSUM S, JSON_TABLE(S.J, 'lax $' COLUMNS(LOW_CNT INT PATH 'lax $.lowStockCount', NESTED PATH 'lax $.latestOrders[*]' COLUMNS(ORD_NO CHAR(6) PATH 'lax $.orderNo', ORD_DATE INT PATH 'lax $.orderDate', LINE_CNT INT PATH 'lax $.lineCount', AMT DECIMAL(11, 2) PATH 'lax $.amount'))) AS T WHERE S.TAG = 'Q3-QUAL' ORDER BY T.ORD_NO DESC

SELECT S.TAG, COUNT(T.ORD_NO) AS N_ORDERS, MAX(T.LOW_CNT) AS LOW_CNT FROM &LIB.VFYSUM S, JSON_TABLE(S.J, 'lax $' COLUMNS(LOW_CNT INT PATH 'lax $.lowStockCount', NESTED PATH 'lax $.latestOrders[*]' COLUMNS(ORD_NO CHAR(6) PATH 'lax $.orderNo'))) AS T GROUP BY S.TAG ORDER BY S.TAG
SELECT COUNT(*) AS TXCKM_0907_LEFT FROM &LIB.TXCKM WHERE LESSON = '09-07'
